manual_all_steps: Open RU/IG_UI_RU.txt and confirm the status bar shows the current file encoding before editing.
Replace one RU value with a real Cyrillic phrase such as `Сохранить игру`, use General -> Save, and choose Write to file if prompted.
Open KO/IG_UI_KO.txt, confirm the status bar shows the current file encoding, replace one KO value with a real Korean phrase such as `설정을 저장`, then save with Write to file if prompted.

Open PTBR/IG_UI_PTBR.txt, confirm the status bar shows the current file encoding, replace one PT-BR value with a real Cp1252-safe phrase such as `Salvar alterações`, then save with Write to file if prompted.
Switch back through RU/IG_UI_RU.txt, KO/IG_UI_KO.txt, and PTBR/IG_UI_PTBR.txt.
Confirm each edited value remains readable with no mojibake after the roundtrip.
manual_checked_expected_checks: No parse or decode error dialogs appear while opening mixed encodings.
Status bar shows the current file encoding for each opened file.
Edits in Cp1251, UTF-16, and Cp1252 files persist after save.
Returning to the edited files does not show mojibake or broken open-save behavior.
